notes: Adds a local Favorites section for Live TV, Movies, and Series.
Adds Continue Watching for movies and series episodes, with saved timestamps and automatic resume.
Refreshes the top-right account expiration display from the server while the app is open and when the app resumes.
Re-checks account status before locally expiring a session, so Dispatcharr-side extensions can be picked up.
Keeps Android 5.0, Fire TV, Android TV, and phone compatibility.
